notes.title: Patch 5.94 - Achievement Bugfix
notes.notes:
The achievement "The Car" was accidentally made unable to be unlocked. This achievement now registers as unlocked.

If you have previously passed the requirements to get the achievement, opening the game will instantly award you with the steam achievement.
